title: Official Rulebook Updated
content: Community, server, base-building, raid, weekday-entry, and faction rules have been consolidated into one official rulebook.

title: Event Team Recruitment
content: The Hive is recruiting active, mature members aged 18+ to coordinate and host daily events including Fight Nights, FFA, CTF, Gun Game, KOTH, and faction battles.

title: Moderator Applications Open
content: Dedicated and active community members can apply to help with support tickets, reports, moderation, and keeping both servers fair.

title: Automatic Spawn-Kill Enforcement
content: Two spawn kills trigger a two-minute temporary ban. After two temporary bans, the next spawn-kill violation results in an automatic permanent ban.

title: Faction Balance Is Live
content: Factions can pool cash and credits, control deposit, withdrawal, and spending permissions, and pay directly from their shared balance.

title: Server Economy Overhaul
content: PvP, base building, active play, and survival now drive a more meaningful economy, while deaths and combat logging carry financial consequences.
